html: <!doctype html><html lang="{{LOCALE}}"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>{{BASE_STYLE}} :root{--ink-band:#000000;--ink-band-op:0.62;--accent:#FFD400;--end-bg:#1E1E23;--end-name-col:#FFFFFF;--end-cta-col:#FFD400;--end-loc-col:#9999A8;--radius-mat:0px;--shadow-mat:none;--band-h-hook:136px;--band-h-cap:96px}#stage{background:#111;overflow:hidden}#stage .scene{position:relative;width:100%;height:100%}#stage .scene .mat{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;border-radius:var(--radius-mat);box-shadow:var(--shadow-mat)}#stage .scene .mat img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center center;animation:kb 4s linear forwards}@keyframes kb{from{transform:scale(1.00)}to{transform:scale(1.12)}}#stage .scene .copy{position:absolute;left:0;right:0}#stage .scene .copy .headline{display:block;font-family:"Navis Serif",serif;font-size:88px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.1;color:#FFFFFF;letter-spacing:-0.02em;padding:0 60px;animation:pop 200ms 50ms cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) both}@keyframes pop{from{transform:scale(0.9);opacity:0}to{transform:scale(1.0);opacity:1}}#stage .scene .copy .headline .hl{color:var(--accent)}#stage .scene .copy .cap{display:block;font-family:"Navis Serif",serif;font-size:64px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.15;color:#FFFFFF;letter-spacing:-0.01em;padding:0 60px;text-align:center}#stage .scene .copy .cap .hl{color:var(--accent)}#stage .scene.hook .copy{top:140px;background:linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0%,rgba(0,0,0,var(--ink-band-op)) 100%);padding:24px 0;min-height:var(--band-h-hook)}#stage .scene.cap-scene .copy{bottom:60px;background:rgba(0,0,0,var(--ink-band-op));padding:16px 0;min-height:var(--band-h-cap)}#stage .scene.end{background:var(--end-bg)}#stage .scene.end .mat{opacity:0.08}#stage .scene.end .copy{position:absolute;left:60px;right:60px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);background:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:28px}#stage .scene.end .copy .end-name{font-family:"Navis Serif",serif;font-size:72px;font-weight:700;color:var(--end-name-col);line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-0.02em}#stage .scene.end .copy .end-cta{font-family:"Navis Serif",serif;font-size:52px;font-weight:500;color:var(--end-cta-col);line-height:1.2}#stage .scene.end .copy .end-location{font-family:"Navis Serif",serif;font-size:40px;font-weight:400;color:var(--end-loc-col);line-height:1.3}#stage .scene:nth-child(2) .mat img{object-position:center 30%}#stage .scene:nth-child(3) .mat img{object-position:center 50%}#stage .scene:nth-child(4) .mat img{object-position:center 60%}#stage .scene:nth-child(5) .mat img{object-position:center 40%}#stage .scene:nth-child(6) .mat img{object-position:center 50%}#stage .scene:nth-child(7) .mat img{object-position:center 50%}#stage .scene:nth-child(8) .mat img{object-position:center 50%}</style></head><body><main id="stage">{{SCENES}}</main>{{PLAYER}}</body></html>
